project_type: TypeScript monorepo - multi-source music aggregator with NestJS backend
build_system: pnpm workspaces (9.15.0), tsc for individual packages
test_framework: vitest for apps/api unit tests, unplugin-swc for decorator support
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm run lint, 2. pnpm run typecheck, 3. pnpm run build, 4. pnpm run test
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated via prisma generate
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Node.js 22. No running DB in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits, ESLint + Prettier enforced, strict TypeScript
key_patterns: KmsService already exists at apps/api/src/kms/kms.service.ts with KmsClient interface (encrypt, decrypt, generateDataKey). KmsModule is already imported in AppModule. PrismaService is global. RedisService extends ioredis. AuditLog model exists in Prisma schema. ConnectedService model has accessTokenCt, refreshTokenCt, dekId fields.
directory_structure: apps/api/src/ contains modules: auth, common, config, health, kms, prisma, redis
